Our AI assistant platform has become a maintenance nightmare. We have duplicate cron jobs running at the same time, systemd services that overlap with each other, shell scripts scattered across the codebase doing the same thing, log files written to a dozen different directories, and outdated documentation. The team has a standard conflict coordination mechanism defined in SKILL.md that we've never properly deployed.

Please set up the official conflict coordination module for this platform. It should be placed under `/workspace/conflict-coordination/`. You'll also need to produce:
1. A file named `conflict-detection.cron` with the correct automated schedule for running conflict detection
2. A file named `coordination-report.md` that catalogs the conflicts found across the platform and documents the correct resolution strategy for each, based on the team's official coordination principles

Make sure everything follows the spec in SKILL.md — including the exact automation schedule and the priority ordering principles. Previous attempts (see the archive/) used the wrong schedule, so double-check.
